chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'By Allah! Even if an idol worshipper were to recite what you (believers) recite at the exit of his soul, the Fire would not consume anything from his body, ever!'

key_terms.تصفون: What you (believers) describe/recite — refers to the talqeen, the Islamic creed and testimony recited at death
key_terms.خروج النفس: Exit of the soul — the moment of death when the soul departs the body
key_terms.طعمت النار: The Fire consuming/tasting — a vivid metaphor for hellfire's punishment
key_terms.عابد وثن: Idol worshipper — one who worships idols or false deities, used here as the extreme hypothetical to emphasize the power of the words

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the talqeen at the time of death according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) makes a remarkable statement about the power of the talqeen — the recitation of the Islamic testimony and creed at the time of death. He declares with an oath that even an idol worshipper who were to recite the same words (the shahadah and the creed) at the moment of his soul's departure would be protected from the Fire. This hadith emphasizes the extraordinary virtue of the talqeen practice, where believers are instructed in the testimony of faith as they approach death, underscoring the immense spiritual power of these words at that critical moment.

en.hubeali: Sohl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abu Bakr Al Hazramy who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Even if an idol worshipper were to describe what you are describe during the exit of his soul, the Fire would not consume anything from his body, ever!’.
en.sarwar: 8. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-ffassan ibn Shammun, from ‘Abd al-Rahman from ‘Abd Allah ibn Qasim from abu Bakr al-Hadramiy who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘By Allah, even if a worshipper of an idol, in his dying condition, says what you say, fire will never consume anything from his body.’”
